cards.card_text: Then Solomon pictures a madman shooting firebrands and deadly arrows.
cards.verse_text: Like a madman shooting firebrands and deadly arrows,

cards.card_text: Then comes a word for anyone who lights their own fire: "Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who array yourselves with firebrands, walk in the light of your fire and of the firebrands you have lit!"
cards.verse_text: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who array yourselves with firebrands, walk in the light of your fire and of the firebrands you have lit!

cards.card_text: The LORD tells them they were like a firebrand snatched from a blaze.
cards.verse_text: “Some of you I overthrew as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a firebrand snatched from a blaze, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD asks about Joshua: "Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire?" Not strolled out.
cards.verse_text: Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire?”
